data.body: Independent-review correction: commit 1de1b4446b98c1955ba44c2ff21d9785fc476529 supersedes unpushed commit 04e85471bb72ac9655c90af4b374cb044b7d0949 on parent a46c50e063bb61e5f91e8684c10986f224d74d00. Full leaf diff is 24 insertions and 52 deletions across the same five declared paths. Immutable oracle PASS with word counts 128 to 50, 92 to 43, 130 to 41, 114 to 50, and 60 to 31; protected physical lines and executable ASTs are exact. No Gerrit push has occurred; fresh independent exact-SHA documentation review is pending.
